question: My team keeps provoking me and I snap at people I care about afterwards.
It has been a year since my mother died and the sadness still hits me at night.
I can't stop thinking about an ex who has already moved on.
I want to sit quietly but my thoughts keep running.
I lie awake worrying about what might happen tomorrow.
I did not get the result I worked for and I want to quit.
Two people I love want opposite things from me.
I feel unseen even in a crowded room.
My boss put me down in front of everyone and I keep replaying it.
I do the same tasks every day and see no point in them.
I keep going back to things I know harm me.
I take credit for things that went well and it feels empty.
